# Vortexsoft Innovations Private Limited

> Vortexsoft Innovations Private Limited is an ISO 27001:2013 certified global technology and business process services company. We deliver full-spectrum **IT & Non-IT Services**, architect custom **AI Automations for Large-Scale and Small-Scale enterprises**, drive **Intelligent BPO Automations**, and stand as **India's Best Title Abstracting Company** with **40+ happy clients** across the United States. Headquartered in Pune and Bengaluru, India, with a U.S. corporate entity in Sheridan, Wyoming.

## Core Strategic Pillars

### 1. India's Best Title Abstracting Company (40+ Happy Clients)
- [Title & Settlement Services](https://www.vortexsoftinnovations.com/title-settlement/): Ranked India's leading title abstracting partner.
- **Client Base**: Over 40+ happy US title insurance underwriters, regional title plants, abstractors, settlement agencies, and real estate law firms.
- **Coverage**: Full nationwide coverage across all 50 US States (including Texas, Florida, California, New York, Pennsylvania, Georgia).
- **Core Deliverables**:
  - Full 30/40/60-Year Historical Title Searches
  - Current Owner & Two-Owner Title Searches
  - Environmental & Municipal Lien Searches
  - Tax Delinquency & Open Mortgage Verifications
  - Easement & Right-of-Way Plotting
  - Title Commitment & Exception Preparation in SoftPro, Qualia, ResWare, and RamQuest
- **SLA & Accuracy**: 99.8% title examination accuracy with 24-to-48 hour turnaround SLAs (express 12-hour delivery available).

### 2. Full-Spectrum IT & Non-IT Services
- **IT Services**: Custom Web Applications (React, Next.js, Node.js, PHP, Python), Enterprise Cloud Architecture, API Integrations, DevOps CI/CD, Cyber Security, and Database Management.
- **Non-IT Services**: Healthcare BPO & Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), Digital Publishing Prepress, Commercial Lease Abstraction, Accounting & AP/AR, Payroll Processing, and Omnichannel Multilingual Customer Care.

### 3. AI Automations for Large-Scale Enterprises and Small-Scale Businesses
- **For Small-Scale Agile Businesses (SMBs)**: Fast-to-deploy workflow bots, customer service copilots, automated lead routing, and document ingestion that reduce manual hours by 60%.
- **For Large-Scale Enterprises**: Complex LLM pipelines, autonomous multi-agent task execution, high-throughput document intelligence, vector retrieval systems, and HIPAA/ISO-compliant private AI deployments.
- **Proprietary AI Platforms**:
  - [VortexEXHO](https://www.vortexsoftinnovations.com/#ai-products): Enterprise Workforce Operating System combining ATS, HRMS, payroll, LMS, and AI copilot.
  - [vortexHire](https://www.vortexsoftinnovations.com/#ai-products): AI resume parsing, candidate scoring, and talent intelligence engine reducing time-to-hire by 70%.
  - [vortexKonnect](https://www.vortexsoftinnovations.com/#ai-products): Call center conversation analytics, acoustic sentiment intelligence, and real-time compliance coaching.
  - [Vortexreach](https://www.vortexsoftinnovations.com/#ai-products): Autonomous B2B sales outreach and multi-channel pipeline generation.
  - [vortexsoftpublishing](https://www.vortexsoftinnovations.com/#ai-products): Automated publishing platform for XML restructuring (JATS, BITS, S1000D) and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility.
  - [vortexsofthrms](https://www.vortexsoftinnovations.com/#ai-products): Enterprise Human Resource Management System with AI automations for autonomous payroll and KPI appraisal.

### 4. Intelligent BPO Automations & Healthcare Operations
- [Healthcare BPO & Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)](https://www.vortexsoftinnovations.com/service.php#healthcare): Medical coding (ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS), electronic claims submission, denial management, and AR recovery under HIPAA guidelines with a 98%+ first-pass claim rate.
- [AI Data Annotation & Computer Vision](https://www.vortexsoftinnovations.com/service.php#annotation): 2D/3D bounding boxes, polygon segmentation, LiDAR point clouds, video tracking, and RLHF text annotation.
- [Accounting & Payroll Operations](https://www.vortexsoftinnovations.com/service.php#finance): Automated Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), statutory compliance, and multi-state payroll.
